title: Open Values Stack Index v0.1
description: A list of fixed copies of a site's facts files, each named by the SHA-256 hash of its contents, so a copy can be checked after download. The site's build writes it.

format.description: Always "open-values-stack-index". Tells a reader that this file lists fixed copies of facts files.

version.description: The version of the stack index format this file follows, 0.1.

generatedAt.description: When the site build wrote this file, as an ISO 8601 date and time in UTC.

sourceDoor.description: The address of the site's door file (/.well-known/open-values.json) that points to this index.

hash.description: Always "sha256": the hash used to name and check each copy.

description.description: A sentence for readers saying what the index holds and that each copy's hash should be checked before it is trusted.

lenses.description: One row for each fixed copy of a facts file.

id.description: The facts file's id, such as "banking".

sha256.description: The SHA-256 hash of the copy's bytes, 64 hexadecimal characters. The copy is named by it.

integrity.description: The same hash written as "sha256-" followed by the hex digest.

path.description: Where the copy is on the site, as /stacks/lens/<id>/<sha256>.json.

url.description: The full address of the copy. It does not change, because a new version of the file gets a new hash and a new address.

canonicalData.description: The address of the live data file, which changes as the facts are updated.

license.description: The address of the licence the data is published under.
